name: cloud-environment
description: Use the cloud computer attached to a Codex chat to work with files and repositories, run software, and troubleshoot access to services.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test projects on your cloud computer
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to build a project, run an app, or create a file using the tools and connections in your cloud environment. If something is missing, Codex can check what the environment provides and help you change its setup.
